build.buildCommand: set -e; corepack enable; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; node scripts/release-clean-gates.mjs; node scripts/release-permission-fix.mjs; node scripts/release-api-contract-fix.mjs; node scripts/release-api-runtime-fix.mjs; pnpm format; pnpm format:check; pnpm lint; node scripts/check-page-truth.mjs; pnpm build; pnpm test:api; pnpm test:workers; tar -czf /app/blueballs-clean-gates.tgz --exclude=node_modules --exclude=dist --exclude=railway.json --exclude=scripts/release-clean-gates.mjs --exclude=scripts/release-permission-fix.mjs --exclude=scripts/release-api-contract-fix.mjs --exclude=scripts/release-api-runtime-fix.mjs .; sha256sum /app/blueballs-clean-gates.tgz > /app/blueballs-clean-gates.sha256; cat /app/blueballs-clean-gates.sha256

deploy.startCommand: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),http=require('node:http'); const files={'/artifact.tgz':'/app/blueballs-clean-gates.tgz','/artifact.sha256':'/app/blueballs-clean-gates.sha256'}; http.createServer((req,res)=>{const file=files[req.url]; if(!file||!fs.existsSync(file)){res.statusCode=404; return res.end('not found');} res.setHeader('content-type',req.url.endsWith('.tgz')?'application/gzip':'text/plain'); fs.createReadStream(file).pipe(res)}).listen(process.env.PORT||3000)"
